classes.name: Barbarian
classes.flavorText: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

features.name: Rage
features.description: You can enter a rage as a bonus action

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, your AC is 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: Go into a frenzy when you rage

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Cannot be charmed or frightened while raging

classes.name: Bard
classes.flavorText: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast spells using a musical instrument as focus

subclasses.name: Lore
subclasses.description: A master of song, speech, and magic

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: Use reaction to reduce attack roll or damage

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: Learn 2 more spells from any class

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: Add inspiration die to any ability check

classes.name: Cleric
classes.flavorText: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare spells from cleric spell list

subclasses.name: Life
subclasses.description: A domain focused on healing and protection

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Healing spells restore extra hit points

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity to heal creatures

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Add radiant damage to weapon attacks

classes.name: Druid
classes.flavorText: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding nature-themed magic and shapeshifting.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare druid spells from the druid spell list

features.name: Druidic
features.description: Know the secret language of druids

subclasses.name: Land
subclasses.description: A druid bonded to a specific environment

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Always prepared spells from land type

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: Recover spell slots during short rest

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Move through difficult terrain and resist charm

classes.name: Fighter
classes.flavorText: A master of martial combat, skilled with weapons and armor.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: Regain HP at end of turn if below half

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: A fighter blending martial skill with arcane magic

features.name: War Magic
features.description: Attack then cast bonus action spell

classes.name: Monk
classes.flavorText: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body and mind.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon

subclasses.name: Open Hand
subclasses.description: A monk focusing on unarmed combat

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: Add effects to Flurry of Blows

features.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
features.description: Extend reach and add fire damage

classes.name: Paladin
classes.flavorText: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath of justice and devotion.

subclasses.name: Devotion
subclasses.description: A paladin bound to justice and virtue

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: Allies within 10 feet resistant to charm

classes.name: Ranger
classes.flavorText: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose a creature type as favored enemy

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: Choose a terrain type as natural explorer

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: A ranger focused on hunting prey

classes.name: Rogue
classes.flavorText: A stealthy trickster who excels at skills, stealth, and striking from the shadows.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double proficiency bonus for two skills or one skill and thieves' tools

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Deal extra damage when you have advantage on attacks

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: Know the secret language of thieves

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: A rogue who excels at stealth and acquisition

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Use Cunning Action for bonus action object interaction or Hide in plain sight

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: Climbing no longer costs extra movement and distance of long jump increases

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Advantage on Stealth checks when you move no more than half speed

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on magic items

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: Two turns during the first round of combat

scalingFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
scalingFeatures.description: Deal extra damage to a creature you hit with advantage on the attack roll

scalingFeatures.name: Expertise
scalingFeatures.description: At 1st level, choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of your skill proficiencies and your proficiency with thieves' tools. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or with thieves' tools) to gain this benefit

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.flavorText: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.flavorText: A spellcaster who draws power from a pact with a powerful entity.

subclasses.name: Fiend
subclasses.description: A warlock with a fiendish patron

classes.name: Wizard
classes.flavorText: A scholarly spellcaster who wields magic through study and arcane knowledge.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast spells using arcane focus and spellbook

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Recover spell slots during short rest

subclasses.name: Evocation
subclasses.description: A wizard specializing in destructive magic

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: Double damage on failed save cantrips

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Add Int modifier to evocation damage
